setup: [a text that looks like it comes from the road toll operator or a parking office says a small toll or parking charge from a recent trip is unpaid]
ask: [the text gives a link to pay the small amount today and warns that a late fee is added after the deadline; the link opens a page that asks for card details]
usualEnding: The small amount is the hook: the card details are used for larger charges, and the same number gets more fake notices.
realTwin: A real notice from [institution] says a toll statement is ready, names the operator's own website in plain text, and says to view and pay it in the official app the player already uses; it asks for nothing else.

source.url: https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202410/28/P2024102800253.htm (HK Transport Department, 28 Oct 2024: fake toll texts link to pages that take card details; the real operator sends no payment links, and tolls are paid in its own app or site). Catalogue entry 42 is the nearest row, not an exact one.
